attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Phishing infrastructure was targeted and dismantled as part of Operation Serengeti III, indicating this technique was used by the criminal networks.

campaigns.name: Operation Serengeti III
campaigns.description: A massive international cybercrime crackdown led by INTERPOL, involving law enforcement from 21 countries between June and August 2026. It resulted in 1,462 arrests and the takedown of 10,909 malicious networks.

identities.name: INTERPOL
identities.description: International Criminal Police Organization that led Operation Serengeti III, a global cybercrime crackdown.

infrastructure.name: Command and Control Servers
infrastructure.description: Command and Control (C2) servers used to manage botnets and control malware-infected computers were dismantled during Operation Serengeti III.

infrastructure.name: Phishing Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Websites and servers used to host fake login pages to steal credentials were dismantled during Operation Serengeti III.

infrastructure.name: Malware Distribution Networks
infrastructure.description: Systems used to host and spread malicious software like ransomware and information stealers were dismantled during Operation Serengeti III.

infrastructure.name: Fraudulent E-commerce Sites
infrastructure.description: Fake online shops designed to steal money and payment card information were dismantled during Operation Serengeti III.

infrastructure.name: Money Laundering Networks
infrastructure.description: Systems used to obscure and transfer illicit funds, often involving cryptocurrency, were dismantled during Operation Serengeti III.
